findings.text: guard_verdict and the grid_motion/window_selection/window_agreement/window_pass helpers the change adds carry no assertion anywhere: nothing in the suite calls them, so a regression in the grid census, the fallback selection or the converted-grid comparison would redden no test and the evidence fragment would keep its old numbers.

the pairwise-distinctness figure 'smallest pairwise max |psi_a - psi_b| = 1.72e-02' cites no artifact under logs/: GRID_BLOCKS and grid_motion.json are reproducible from measure.log, but this number came from an ad-hoc session script and is recorded nowhere a later reader can re-run it.

item_verdicts.call_sites: no production call site reaches the change: the only importer of scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answer/measure is its own test file test_coverage.py, and nothing under nova/, apps/ or tests/ imports the module.

item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names three measured items; the gate that ran (baseline_suite/after_suite over scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answer and scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/test_orientation.py) asserts item (3), and items (1)-(2) are measurements recorded in docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/tcv-liuqe-corrected-reference.html and in logs/guard.json, logs/grid_motion.json and logs/window.json.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to read the TCV 77549 LIUQE known answer from imas-efit's sign-corrected reference rather than the uncorrected input pulse; measure.py:65 SOURCE_LIUQE_STORE and test_coverage.py:40 now default to /home/ITER/mcintos/public/efit/validation/TCV/77549/liuqe-corrected and the uncorrected path is gone from the readers.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits f09aa6924, 6c80af045, 8e41e37e5, baseline_suite 1 failed, after_suite 0 failed, negative_control_log EXIT=1 refusing slice 34 with ReferenceSignError.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source brief fenced scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answer/measure.py, scripts/prototypes/tcv_liuqe_known_answer/test_coverage.py and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/tcv-liuqe-corrected-reference.html plus logs; the diff touches exactly those three and no fourth file.

justifications.durability: test_coverage.py:40 feeds the pre-existing test_limited_slice_is_read_only_when_coverage_is_certified from the corrected default and negative_control.log reddens it on the uncorrected store, but the added measurement helpers carry no assertion at all.
justifications.evidence: baseline_suite.log ends '1 failed, 31 passed' at 234be9a8e and after_suite.log ends '32 passed' EXIT=0 at f09aa6924, both with a bare EXIT= line, so the no-added-failure claim is recorded rather than asserted.
justifications.fit: the added constants and helpers follow the module's existing docstring-and-dataclass idiom of measure.py:117 and introduce no version, plan or ticket token in any name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: measure.py:65 and test_coverage.py:40 both default to the corrected DD 3.41.0 source and the fragment records 17 of 17 guard agreements with the grid-motion and window items measured.
justifications.reuse: guard_verdict wraps check_axis_boundary_sign from scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/orientation.py rather than reimplementing it, and a capability search over scripts/ and nova/ found no existing owner for the optional IDS-child, grid-block or window-agreement helpers.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 234be9a8e..8e41e37e5 changes only measure.py, test_coverage.py and the evidence fragment, each inside the brief's declared write paths.
